units.source_text: “不，说来说去都怪村里的人手不足嘛。

en.t: No, when all is said and done, it is because the village is short of people.

units.source_text: ……有钱人也好，穷人也好，有活干的都一个接一个地离开了村子……

en.t: Rich or poor, anyone who could find work left the village one after another.

units.source_text: 总之，这里只有沙，是个穷村子哇……”

en.t: In short, there is nothing here but sand. It is a poor village...
